items.proposal_title: Dual-target Fin-JEPA for raw dynamics and denoised market state
items.proposal_summary: Train one predictor against the ordinary future encoder latent and a second head against a denoised, volatility-aware state target, forcing shared context features to preserve fast dynamics while exposing a smoother decision-relevant state.
items.mechanistic_rationale: Train one predictor against the ordinary future encoder latent and a second head against a denoised, volatility-aware state target, forcing shared context features to preserve fast dynamics while exposing a smoother decision-relevant state.
items.falsifiable_test: Compare raw-target JEPA, denoised-target-only JEPA, dual-target JEPA, and shuffled-denoising controls on equities, Bitcoin, and FX with identical walk-forward splits.
items.primary_metric: held-out downstream state classification at matched latent prediction error

items.proposal_summary: Skip denoising and learn directly from raw noisy labels for intraday volatility state.
items.mechanistic_rationale: Noise itself may preserve microstructure stress transitions that smoothing removes.
items.falsifiable_test: Run matched pipelines with and without denoising under identical walk-forward splits.
items.primary_metric: Raw labels should preserve intraday volatility-state transitions better than denoised labels.

items.proposal_title: Calibrated latent-distribution Fin-JEPA for regime-specific abstention
items.proposal_summary: Replace point latent prediction with a calibrated latent distribution and use context-only regime strata to test whether uncertainty supports abstention. Regime detection and multi-horizon prediction are controls inherited from Fin-JEPA future work; the distinct hypothesis is calibrated distributional uncertainty tied to risk-coverage.

Regime detection and multi-horizon prediction are controls inherited from Fin-JEPA future work; the distinct hypothesis is calibrated distributional uncertainty tied to risk-coverage.
items.falsifiable_test: Walk-forward equity and FX evaluation with regime labels fit inside each training fold; compare point JEPA, the paper's regime and multi-horizon future-work baseline, distributional JEPA, and calibrated abstention.
items.primary_metric: out-of-sample latent negative log likelihood with calibration error

items.proposal_summary: Use JEPA latent prediction error as a direct discriminator for daily return direction.
items.mechanistic_rationale: Prediction misses may encode underreacted state transitions rather than pure representation error.
items.falsifiable_test: Compare latent-error thresholding with size-matched random and lagged-error controls.
items.primary_metric: Error-threshold portfolios should separate forward returns from matched latent-fidelity controls.

items.proposal_summary: Occupy missing finance cell mechanism=behavioral|target=liquidity|horizon=weekly with a target-bound report-only candidate.
items.mechanistic_rationale: The chosen mechanism may expose an underexplored target and horizon combination in the current archive.
items.falsifiable_test: Compare against neighboring occupied cells and shuffled target assignments.
items.primary_metric: A target-bound card should be scorable and traceable even before any runtime authorization decision.

items.proposal_title: Event-conditioned financial JEPA with causal relevance gating
items.proposal_summary: Encode timestamp-safe earnings and dynamically selected exogenous context separately, open a relevance gate only when that context adds predictive information beyond price history, and train the gated context to predict future market latents across event-time windows. The causal relevance gate is imported from external GS-FUSE/CAMEF prior art and is not an approved-corpus fact.

items.primary_metric: event-window future-latent prediction gain over price-only JEPA

items.proposal_summary: Assume earnings context stays decision-relevant beyond the immediate event window.
items.mechanistic_rationale: Post-release repricing may diffuse slowly enough that stale earnings context still anchors flow.
items.falsifiable_test: Extend the event window and compare against timestamp-purged decay baselines.
items.primary_metric: Holding event-conditioned state features after the standard window should still improve signal decay forecasts.
